ScopedAPIKey.description: Choose permissions in Settings > API. Never pass the root token to a bot.

artifact_checksum.description: Required 64 lowercase hex for successful staging; empty for simulation.

online.description: Database clock freshness, independent of client clock

traffic.description: Optional initial host traffic settings. Create may omit version and add initial_used_bytes; calibrate after Agent is connected to align with provider history.

group_ids.description: Optional; omitted preserves memberships, empty removes all

reset_anchor_at.description: Optional cycle anchor; preserve omitted anchor. Original monthly day clamped on short months.

external_id.description: Unique external panel account ID; empty clears it on PUT. Omission preserves it.

version.description: PUT optimistic concurrency version returned by GET; stale value returns 409.

multiplier_milli.description: 1000=1x. Only new traffic uses the new rate; previously billed usage is retained.

max_devices.description: 0 adds no limit. Effective limit is strictest nonzero user/group value. Enabling a limit removes the generic user credential; use per-device subscriptions. This is credential slot enforcement, not physical hardware attestation.

device_limit_mode.description: Compatible counts 7-day subscription observations by source IP + client format, not physical devices. Strict mode requires X-Hwid and deploys independent identities.
Compatible counts 7-day subscription observations by source IP + client format, not physical devices. Strict mode requires X-Hwid and deploys independent identities.

dns.description: DNS configuration independent of base options and routing

mode.description: RX/TX are from the host interface perspective. max uses cumulative period totals.

interfaces.description: Empty selects OS-detected uplink interfaces; selecting an interface never retroactively adds its old counters.
